overview:
David Kustoff seeks another term in a west Tennessee district that leans Republican by about ten points. He enters with a large financial advantage, having raised over $2.2 million and holding roughly $3 million on hand, while Democratic nominee Heidi Kuhn has raised under $40,000. Several independent candidates are on the ballot but show little fundraising activity.

No public general-election polling covers the race, and no expert raters have flagged it as competitive. Prediction markets give Republicans about a 95% chance of holding the seat. The combination of district lean, incumbency, and money points to a comfortable Republican win, with the main uncertainty being turnout patterns rather than a genuine contest.
